    02 The idea

    Money moves in circles, and so do plates. A coin is only a plate for value: you load it, pass it, and somebody else reaches out to take it. We took that picture literally. Platecoin is the plate. It lives on Solana, it keeps its books in the open, and it shows you the whole market beside it, so you never have to take our word for how busy the room is.

    06 The token

    One plate.
    One symbol.

    Platecoin is a holder-run token on Solana with a deliberately small footprint: a name, a mark, a public address and a market you can watch. Whatever is not confirmed stays visibly blank instead of being filled in with hope.

    07 Phases

    Four stacks of plates.

    I

    Set the plate

    Go live on Solana. The address appears in the slot at the top of this page and on our official X.

    II

    Open the board

    The coin takes the first row of the market board, pinned above everything else.

    III

    Fill the rack

    More holders, more hands, more trades. We publish what is confirmed and leave the rest blank.

    IV

    Pass it around

    Community-led growth, and the open-source repository once it is ready to show.

    A plate stays round because it keeps going. So do we.
